# fsh

Writes and fixes FHIR Shorthand (FSH) for SUSHI, including profiles, extensions, value sets, code systems, instances, invariants, rule sets, logical models, slicing and sushi-config.yaml. Use when someone authors or debugs .fsh files, asks how to express a FHIR constraint in FSH, or hits a SUSHI error. Covers FSH 3.0.0, SUSHI 3.x and FHIR R4.

The skill itself, with its resources, scripts and evals, is [`skills/fsh/SKILL.md`](../../../skills/fsh/SKILL.md) (evals: [`evals/fsh/`](../../../evals/fsh/)).
